name: tmessaoudi/scout
description: scout — one self-hosted watcher, several domains: rental listings (rent) and used cars (car) in Île-de-France, and job alerts (job)

suggest.ext-pcntl: Clean shutdown of `scout run --watch`: without it a SIGTERM kills the process mid-pass instead of after it, which is how a redeploy produces duplicate notifications. WatchLoop degrades gracefully and says so on its banner.
